_about: Methanol (1) + Water (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.32 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of methanol, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of methanol, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: C. Yang, S. Ma, X. Yin, Organic Salt Effect of Tetramethylammonium Bicarbonate on the Vapor Liquid Equilibrium of the Methanol Water System, J. Chem. Eng. Data 56 (2011) 3747-3751
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 3, 4. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0090. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.20 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
